tests.test: A strike has three distinct scales, forward motion, and a two-sided fan
Shards inherit vertex colors and wood splinters use slim silhouettes
Only large chunks collide; their colliders fit shards and leave a wall breach passable
Retained walls use bounded chips while the structural simulation carries their mass
Repeated hits and many buildings respect global particle and rigid-body caps
Reset cancels delayed collapses and pooled bodies never create ghost debris
Fragment motion is identical at 30, 60, and 144 Hz rendering
